experiment: VGGT point association TRAIN finite window scan
cause: The shared source stamp intentionally invalidated the in-flight calibration after adding legacy-Pillow resampling compatibility. This is an engineering provenance stop, not a model-quality result.
remediation: Re-registered the unchanged TRAIN budget with the new source stamp and restarted both partitions on CUDA devices 3 and 7. Existing mismatched/incomplete windows are preserved as interrupted attempts and are not reused.
